title: Mobile AI Developer Path
goal: Learn to add AI features (LLMs, on-device models) to Android and iOS apps, building a portfolio project and preparing for job interviews.

phases.title: Introduction and Setup
phases.goal: Set up development environment and understand the basics of AI and mobile app development.

phases.title: Basics of Mobile App Development
phases.goal: Learn the fundamentals of Android and iOS app development using Swift and Kotlin.

phases.title: Introduction to AI and Machine Learning
phases.goal: Understand the basics of AI and machine learning, including LLMs and on-device models.

phases.title: Building an AI Feature for iOS
phases.goal: Create an AI-powered feature for an iOS app, focusing on integrating on-device models.

phases.title: Building an AI Feature for Android
phases.goal: Create an AI-powered feature for an Android app, focusing on integrating on-device models.

phases.title: Project and Portfolio Preparation
phases.goal: Prepare a polished portfolio project and practice for job interviews.

phases.title: Job Application and Interview Preparation
phases.goal: Apply for jobs and prepare for technical interviews.

tasks.title: Set up Development Environment
tasks.why: Ensure the learner has the necessary tools and knowledge to start coding.
steps: Set up a playground folder for the portfolio project
tasks.doneWhen: Development environment is set up and playground folder is created.
tasks.check: The learner can open Android Studio and Xcode.

tasks.title: Understand Basic Mobile App Development
tasks.why: Gain a foundational understanding of app development.
tasks.doneWhen: The learner understands the basic structure and workflow of Android and iOS app development.
tasks.check: The learner can explain the basic structure of an Android and iOS app.

tasks.title: Learn Swift
tasks.why: Learn the Swift programming language for iOS app development.
tasks.doneWhen: The learner can write basic Swift code.
tasks.check: The learner can write and run a simple Swift program.

tasks.title: Learn Kotlin
tasks.why: Learn the Kotlin programming language for Android app development.
tasks.doneWhen: The learner can write basic Kotlin code.
tasks.check: The learner can write and run a simple Kotlin program.

tasks.title: Introduction to AI and Machine Learning
tasks.why: Understand the basics of AI and machine learning.
steps: Read AI and machine learning articles
Watch introductory videos on AI and machine learning
tasks.doneWhen: The learner has a basic understanding of AI and machine learning.
tasks.check: The learner can explain the concept of a neural network.

tasks.title: Introduction to LLMs
tasks.why: Understand the basics of LLMs and their applications.
tasks.doneWhen: The learner has a basic understanding of LLMs.
tasks.check: The learner can explain the concept of a language model.

tasks.title: Integrate LLM in iOS App
tasks.why: Integrate an LLM feature in an iOS app.
steps: Add a text input and output view
Test the app with sample inputs
tasks.doneWhen: The app can take user input, process it with an LLM, and display the output.
tasks.check: The learner can run the app and see the LLM in action.

tasks.title: Integrate LLM in Android App
tasks.why: Integrate an LLM feature in an Android app.
steps: Add a text input and output view
Test the app with sample inputs
tasks.doneWhen: The app can take user input, process it with an LLM, and display the output.
tasks.check: The learner can run the app and see the LLM in action.

tasks.title: Prepare Portfolio Project
tasks.why: Prepare a polished portfolio project for job interviews.
tasks.doneWhen: The portfolio project is polished and ready for presentation.
tasks.check: The learner can demonstrate the portfolio project to a peer.

tasks.title: Job Application and Interview Preparation
tasks.why: Prepare for job interviews and application.
tasks.doneWhen: The learner has a polished LinkedIn profile and a list of practice questions.
tasks.check: The learner can answer a set of common interview questions.
